meta.note: Counts are LinkedIn profiles of Queen's alumni. Career families under 5 people in a column or year are folded into 'smaller_groups', and links under 5 are dropped (`suppressed` gives their total once it reaches that floor); employers and titles are named only when at least 10 people share them. Every published count carries a small deterministic perturbation (cell-key method, at most 2 people either way), so parts need not add up exactly to their totals. Sankey stages are the years every member of the slice has reached; `years` goes further, and each year's shares are of that year's `n` (the members who have reached it: in a 5-year class, later years cover the earlier classes only).
